mentions.name: Rootless on-demand application workspace
mentions.description: A rootless, namespace-based on-demand application workspace where each app component runs in a heavily locked down container. Components are built and deployed in a web workspace with sandboxed terminals (with coding-agent access limited to the component's code and the user's home directory), heavy RBAC, and least-privilege permissions. It is designed for the agentic era, where apps are built on demand every few minutes and existing systems weren't built to handle that; it may be open sourced.
mentions.problem: Current systems weren't built to deal with a whole new app being built every few minutes, and Claw-style agents still feel like school projects.
mentions.audience: Individuals deploying an infrastructure-grade application workspace for themselves, with agents building apps inside it
mentions.source_excerpt: Building a rootless, namespace powered (deeply stretching the definition of a container), on demand application workspace.
mentions.author: devttyeu
